[EN] No matter what you do, do not relieve yourself in the Lake of Tears. There was quite a row with Kaiator when we nearly slew a dozen amani tourists who thought the lake was for bathing!
[ES] No importa lo que hagas, no te alivies en el Lake of Tears. ¡Hubo un gran altercado con Kaiator cuando casi matamos a una docena de turistas amani que pensaban que el lago era para bañarse!
